This case is amazing, not only is it sturdy and well-made, it holds a lot of items due to the ability to configure the inside. I used it to store all my skincare and makeup items for travel. While it does take up space in a suitcase, it is well worth it because I was not worried the material would be crushed causing my tube containers to squeeze out.  I would buy this again and again if needed more storage. I purchased this 3-layer one and the 2-layer one.

I ended up returning this item because it was smaller than I anticipated and weighed a ton.  The compartments weren't convenient if you are super organized like I am.  I got about half my makeup in it and then decided it was the wrong case for me.  Thankfully their customer service had no issues with my return; they paid to have it shipped back and gave me a full refund.

I love love love this bag! I purchased this bag to store all of my makeup at home. I’m living in a tiny space and needed to store my makeup in a way that it would not take up the entire counter. While I do hate that my makeup is not as easily accessible because I have to bring the case out BUT this is what I have to do to make more use of my space. reviews.t: This is great. I had to try it as soon as I received it.
reviews.x: I recently bought what looked like one of these elsewhere. It was soft sided and had no dividers. And it was too small. This one is great. It has some reinforcement to the sides and the dividers will sorta snap into the grooves if you push on the longer horizontal one. The mirror is a nice size and I like that it attaches with velcro. I like the area for brushes under  the flap. I had to put all of my makeup in it as soon as I got it today. I have soooo much left over room.

Need to get the right size products to fit the sections and height. travel sizes work good, but if you are gone for a longer time that may not be enough product. (Mouthwash bottle for example.)  It keeps things easy to find.  No more digging around in a bag to find what we need, you can see it all laid out in front of you.  The only real problem I have is if you put toothbrushes in the zipper sections, you need to be sure to get them laying just right for it to close properly. Hair brushes don't

Purchased this bag to store my dip powders & everything else that goes along with them after another one in a similar style did not work out and so far this one is PERFECT. It feels like good quality, smooth zippers and dividers adjust easy. I have almost 30 1oz jars of dip powder, 3 sets of liquids, cuticle oil, files, buffers, orange sticks, tools and brushes crammed in there and everything fits with some room for a little more left. Very happy so far.

reviews.t: Finally, all my make up in one place!
reviews.x: I absolutely love this case! I went from an over flowing non-zippable make up bag, with random pallets in both bathrooms and my brushes in my bedroom. I now have everything in one closable case! Granted it weighs about 15-20 pounds with everything in it. It’s easy to clean as well! I had some powder falling out of a compact and it was rubbed into the bottom. A little micellular water and a cotton pad, the make up cleaned right up! It’s sturdy to boot! Would recommend buying this.

As a growing lash tech I needed a bigger bag to accommodate my ever growing lash supplies and I must say I’m ecstatic with this purchase!! The bag is large enough to fit everything I need and more. I love how sturdy it is and how it holds it’s shape rather than collapses if squished. The compartments were the perfect size to fit my lash trays and I adjusted the slots to suit my needs. The shoulder strap is convenient for when I have extra items or need to be hands free. And the mirror is an adde
It is extremely well made and very nice to be able to organize everything. Check the size as it is large, but if you need something to hold everything-this is the case for you.
It is extremely well made and very nice to be able to organize everything. Check the size as it is large, but if you need something to hold everything-this is the case for you.

This is a great bag. I use it for cosmetics & hair products in the large compartment. In the smaller compartment, I can fit my surface go, earbuds, phone & charging cords. It actually works great for flying as your smaller travel bag.

I bought this for my granddaughter, it exceeded my expectations with its versatility and sturdiness. She loves it because it can be configured to suit her make up. I highly recommend this product, and it's a great value.
Very very big u can pack body wash and more in this bag

I’m so happy that I found a solution to my makeup woes. My makeup was housed in three different makeup bags. Rolling around, powder everywhere, occasional liquid leaks. A ball of confusion. This bag houses all of my makeup collection with space to grow. The case is sturdy and the zippers are quality. It is rigid enough to protect the contents if something is stacked on it. I’m buying another 2 cases for my nail care, hair care and maybe another for my skincare tools.

The rubber lining on the inside wasnt glued completely and wasnt cut right so therefore it was bulging out. (If cut correctly itd lay flat) one of the pieces that serves as a separator wasnt glued to the piece of cardboard at all. Do yourself a favor and purchase the actual sephora train case.

reviews.t: Perfect for my needs but has a funny manufacturing smell
reviews.x: I love the size, it's so roomy and perfect for my daughter who is on the traveling dance team! I would have given it 5 stars but it has a really strong odor from the material. I'm hoping it goes away sooner rather than later!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the case as sturdy and well-made, holding its shape and featuring quality zippers.
Many reviewers highlight that the adjustable dividers and compartments make it easy to organize and fit a large amount of makeup or supplies.
Several reviewers note the case is large and spacious, though some found it smaller than anticipated or bulky and heavy.
A few reviewers mention the case takes up space or is heavy, especially when fully packed.
Some reviewers note that fitting products requires the right size items, with travel sizes working best.
